The '''2021–22 Danish Superliga''' (officially the '''3F Superliga''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 32nd season of the [[Danish Superliga]]. [[Brøndby IF|Brøndby]] were the defending champions. The season began on 16 July 2021 and ended on 29 May 2022.

==Teams==
[[Lyngby Boldklub]] (relegated after two years in the top flight) and [[AC Horsens]] (relegated after five years in the top flight) finished the [[2020–21 Danish Superliga|2020–21 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2021–22 Danish 1st Division|2021–22 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2020–21 Danish 1st Division|2020–21 1st Division]] champions [[Viborg FF]], who returned after four years of absence, as well as the runners-up [[Silkeborg IF]] who returned after a one-year absence.
